messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (≈ 0.1 atm) water’s freezing (melting) point is **about –2 °C**.  
This is slightly below the normal 0 °C at 1 atm, reflecting the fact that the solid–liquid equilibrium line on the water phase diagram slopes downward as pressure decreases.
